Refactor two node:test files in /root/bench-runs/h4-b3949ce2: test/startup.test.mjs and test/persistence.test.mjs. Coverage must stay the same or grow; do not delete test cases. Do NOT edit server.mjs, public/ or test/helpers/*.

Rules: ES module, built-ins only, exact-equality asserts, no console.log, functions < 50 lines, files ≤ 400 lines, never swallow errors.

The helper /root/bench-runs/h4-b3949ce2/test/helpers/server.mjs now exports (read it): MSG (spec error messages incl. MSG.internal), expectError(res, status, message), exists(path) (false only on ENOENT, rethrows others), withTmpDir(fn), withServer(opts, fn) where opts = {cwd, env, script}, uniqueDate(), and startServer/request now have timeouts.

Fixes:
1. Remove local duplicates: startup.test.mjs `exists` (line ~12, swallows all errors) and `withServer` (~32); persistence.test.mjs `withDir`, `withServer`, `exists`, assertInternalError if it is just status+body+type (use expectError(res, 500, MSG.internal)). Use the helper versions (persistence's withServer(dir, dataFile, fn) calls become withServer({ cwd: dir, env: { DATA_FILE: dataFile } }, fn)).
2. startup.test.mjs ~line 172: the connect-poll loop that runs until the child exits must have an upper bound (e.g. stop after 5 s or 500 attempts and fail the test with a clear message if the server has not exited by then). Also check listenLine (~42) is bounded.
3. startup.test.mjs ~line 293 `failsWith`: simplify so it takes plain values (e.g. failsWith(setup, dataFileEnvValue)) and drop the unused returned `name` / `expectedName`; keep every case.
4. Write invisible characters as \u escapes (startup.test.mjs ~290 and anywhere: grep `-nP '[^\x00-\x7F]'`); keep 'données.json' readable as 'données.json' plus a comment, Arabic-Indic / fullwidth digits as escapes.
5. Rename terse helpers if unclear (`sub` → `tmpPath`, `msg` → `dataError`).
Run `cd /root/bench-runs/h4-b3949ce2 && node --test test/startup.test.mjs test/persistence.test.mjs` until green; report the test count (was 79 combined) and line counts.

- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.
